name: ADR 0001 — Scratch Demo decision
description: Validate the IcePanel REST import + ADR create flow end to end.
content:
# ADR 0001 — Scratch Demo decision

## Status
Accepted

## Context
We need to confirm the IcePanel REST API can create landscapes, import C4 model objects + connections, and create ADRs before launching the multi-agent modeling push.

## Decision
Use the bulk import endpoint (`POST /landscapes/{id}/versions/{versionId}/import`) for objects + connections, and the ADR create endpoint for decision records.

## Consequences
- One import call per landscape handles ID resolution.
- ADRs are created individually after import.
